nodeGroups.name: Load request text
nodeGroups.description: Validates the request, fetches and reads a PDF when only a link is given, then routes emails and CVs to their analysis

nodeGroups.name: Analyze email
nodeGroups.description: Runs rule-based phishing checks, then summarizes, classifies and scores the email and drafts a reply for HR

nodeGroups.name: Assess candidate CV
nodeGroups.description: Extracts candidate profile from the CV, scores skills and experience against the job offer, drafts an acknowledgement

nodeGroups.name: Submit for HR review
nodeGroups.description: Emails HR the analysis and proposed reply with a form to approve, edit or reject it, waiting up to 7 days

nodeGroups.name: Await HR decision
nodeGroups.description: Reads the HR answer: approved and edited replies go out, rejections trigger a new draft up to 3 tries

nodeGroups.name: Send approved reply
nodeGroups.description: Only after HR approval: emails the original or HR-edited reply to the recipient

nodeGroups.name: Update application follow-up
nodeGroups.description: For CV requests, records the candidate as acknowledged in the applications table, then marks the run complete

nodeGroups.name: Return final result
nodeGroups.description: Builds the standard JSON result, saves it to the history table and returns it to the orchestrator
